item.title: github: Multi-repo support and other improvements for GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams
item.description:
GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams now supports multi-repository conversations, letting users work across several repos in one thread. The update also includes model and repository-related improvements.

  • Source: GitHub
